title: Long-Term Follow-up Study for Multiple Myeloma Patients Who Received Study Treatment (Plerixafor or Placebo) in the AMD3100-3102 Study (NCT00103662).
brief_summary: This is a long-term observational study of patients that were treated with at least 1 dose of study treatment (plerixafor or placebo) in the AMD3100-3102 protocol (NCT00103662).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who received a dose of study treatment (plerixafor or placebo) in protocol AMD3100-3102 (NCT00103662)

Exclusion Criteria:

* No Exclusion Criteria
study_population: Patients from the AMD3100-3102 study (NCT00103662) who received a at least one dose of study treatment (plerixafor or placebo).
